notes.title: Plant limit increase & new QOL improvements - Patch 1.5
notes.content:
Dear Gardeners!

We want to thank you all for your patience on this long-time coming patch! Some of you may have already hears some whispers of our up-and-coming features through our Discord channel. 

Time goes by and we're still in awe of all your garden creations. You're all getting more and more creative, and we're proud of it! A great community is also growing on discord, so don't hesitate to join us and share your thoughts and creations.

This is the biggest patch yet and contains some quality-of-life improvements we would not have been able to discover without the input from all of you. 

[h3]Patch 5 at a glance: [/h3]
[list][*] Save game back up system
[*] Plant limit increase option
[*] Sort button
[*] New flower inventory
[*] New cutting tool 'Snips' 
[*] Holding down single transfer keeps transferring more items
[*] Information banner in the main menu
[*] Soft lock fixed when interacting with the customization board and credits
[*] Further fixes to climbing plants growth patterns[/list]
[h3]Save game back up system[/h3]
After hearing the hardships and working with you to discover this issue, we have implemented a back up system that will keep a copy of the saved file in a different folder. No need to enable this it will run quietly in the background as you play. 

To access the save files enter into your file explorer (copy and paste): 

%localappdata%\GardenLife\Saved\SaveGames

To access the backup save files enter into your file explorer (this will be dependent on where you game installation folder is located: 

“your_game_installation_folder”\GardenLife\Backups

and the easiest way to get to the game installation folder is by right clicking the game in your steam library, Manage > Browse local files. 

When replacing make sure you take note of the save slot you’d like to replace and keep the file names first part. Remove all numbers after “arz”. For example to place the first slot in garden life save I would: 
Close the game entirely.

1.	Enter %localappdata%\GardenLife\Saved\SaveGames into my file explorer. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43282354/7e3f195d1888e5d7908e23287814a968b6b17bea.png[/img]
2.	Locate the file to replace this in the back up system.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43282354/be86fe174dfb5c7b688fdda8e818195e14a2eab2.png[/img]
There are multiple back ups of each save game, you may have to try several before locating the one that has the correct save. 

3.	Copy the back up file and paste into the folder:
%localappdata%\GardenLife\Saved\SaveGames

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43282354/31c3a23bc538b9cbf6165219e2b14e2d21e2fddf.png[/img]
4.	Delete the broken save file and rename the newly added file to match the broken save. (right click on the desired file and select ‘rename’)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43282354/0b1c683c0385e6b74b519e3d1e4051b6d5b2dfa8.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43282354/a7c582b121fa21147af1bae64027dd2217c780ab.png[/img]
Launch the game and check the save slot edited. 

[h3]Plant limit increase option for PC[/h3]
You told us, we tested, and now introducing the ability to increase the limit on the amount of plants you can have in your garden. 

To answer the frequently asked question; why do we need a plant limit in the first place? The answer is simple, to save your PC performance. Not everyone has the same hardware, balancing the performance vs how many plants you want to have in your garden has been something we tested with the community on our discord. 

These tests were vital in being able to gather the information to make an informed choice. Now you will have the ability to change the option from medium (the original limit) to high. 

This comes with a warning, when placing plants your pc may experience some struggles on taking care of that many plants. Check to see if you’re experiencing a slow down or use a lower quality setting to see if this improves. 

If you have already planted more than the limit and would like to re-introduce the medium limit, simply select the option in the settings menu, quit to the main menu or travel to the village square, ending the day will not change the plants in your garden to the right limit. You will receive the excess plants back into your inventories, the game will decide which plants to take you back down to the medium limit. Remember you can always remove plants and get the seed back by using the shovel tool. 

[h3]Sort button[/h3]
The sort button, this quality of life feature now allows you to quickly sort items in your shed inventories. Holding down the button labelled ‘sort’ will automatically sort your items alphabetically (keeping the plant groupings). 

Don’t worry, we added the hold, so it is not instant! After seeing the efforts and stunning organisational skills you players have gone to we wanted to make sure this allows you to still keep the order you’d like. 

[h3]New flower inventory[/h3]
In line with all the helpful feedback received on inventory management, the flower storage was a community suggestion. 
When you enter your shed, you’ll notice some empty buckets. This is the all-new flower storage, the only thing that can exist in here is cut flowers and cuttings from your plants. Making an easier time on sorting through which cuttings you want to store for both requests and to complete the pavilion!
After the update you can now only take flowers and cuttings out of the seed storage, they will stay where they are until you remove them. Once removed you cannot put them back in the seed storage from now on.

[h3]New cutting tool 'Snips' [/h3]
The snips you can purchase from the shop for a price (in story mode or free in creative mode!) This new tool will allow you with just one cut, remove all flowers from that plant, freeing up that time spent searching for the exact spot and keeping the shape of your desired plant!
Holding down single transfer keeps transferring more items
When splitting a stack, when you hold the button to split this will tick up, allowing you to create larger stacks of items for delivery to whoever needs them!

[h3]Information banner in the main menu[/h3]
A banner containing updates from our lovely publisher Nacon.
This banner will keep you up to date with news and activities surrounding Garden Life, as well as new releases and promotions on other Nacon game Life games. 

Warm whishes,
The Garden Life team 🌼

notes.title: Cloud saves are now available!
notes.content:
Dear players,

Today we have big news for Steam players: cloud saves are now available! If you play on two machines (PC/PC or PC/Steam Deck), you'll have now to choose the save you want to keep. 

Before making your choice, press windows + R on your keyboard and enter the following: %localappdata%\GardenLife\Saved\SaveGames, and copy/paste your saves to a safe place, in case you lose them.

[u][b]Be careful, the choice is final and irreversible. [/b][/u]

At the same time, we're continuing to pay close attention to all your feedback, and in particular to problems linked to crashes and various major bugs, and we're working on a first patch which should arrive shortly. 

Many thanks for your patience.

notes.title: Bug support!
notes.content:
Dear Gardeners!

Garden Life has been available for 5 days now, and we'd like to thank you for your incredible support.

After months of development, it's just incredible to see the project come to life in the hands of players, and the team at Stillalive Studios or Nacon is very proud to see you enjoying and relaxing on the game!

We've taken note of all your feedback on social networks, Discord and Steam. Naturally, we'll need to carry out a full analysis to see what solutions we can provide, and in what timeframe. 

We are looking into the most pressing issues like crashes first so you can play the game uninterrupted.
Other feedback we have gotten and that we forwarded to our development team is: inventory sorting, pruning process, days being too short, plant limits and more.

Note that a solution can already correct some crashes by forcing the game to launch with DirectX 11. Here's how to do it:
- right-click on Garden Life in your Steam library
- click "Properties..."
- go to "General" tab
- in the "Launch Options" field write "-d3d11"

A FAQ is also available on the forum: https://steamcommunity.com/app/1915380/discussions/0/4340977379960931230/.


We'll keep you posted on the progress of the fixes, but in the meantime, don't hesitate to share your feedback with us!

Warm whishes,
The Garden Life team 🌼

notes.title: Play Garden Life Now! (FAQ!)
notes.content:
Dear Gardeners!

After hard months of development, Garden Life: A Cozy Simulator is now ready to welcome you into its warm and colorful world. Whether you are a green-fingered expert, nature lover, or gamer looking for a new "cozy" world, you are sure to enjoy this game concept where nature and a passion for flowers take centre stage.

Design your ideal garden with the variety of plants and ornaments available, and then expand it as you see fit using the various unlockable structures. Plant your seeds wherever you want, and set up pathways and decorations to create the ideal garden. Our specially developed growth simulation technology ensures that each plant thrives independently while adapting to its surroundings. There are over 120 plants (including color variations) and 245 ornaments to discover, allowing you to express your creativity.

[b]Check out the Launch Trailer on YouTube:[/b] 
[previewyoutube=8yKkiEJlkU4;full][/previewyoutube]
[u]Buy the game now:[/u]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1915380/Garden_Life_A_Cozy_Simulator/

[h1]Frequently Asked Questions[/h1]
For the full FAQ, check the FAQ post on our Steam forums. Be careful, the FAQ can contain minor spoils.

[b]What is Garden Life?[/b]
Garden Life is a relaxing gardening game in which you create your dream garden in a peaceful, colourful world.

[b]Is Garden Life a real gardening simulation?[/b]
No, we took inspiration from real life gardening and created a cozy game simulating the rewarding parts of gardening. Flowers bloom much faster than in real life and are not affected by changing seasons, even winter.

[b]Is the game Steam Deck compatible?[/b]
The game is fully playable on Steam Deck, but some numbers and letters might appear small.

[b]Is a Mac version planned?[/b]
There are currently no plans for a Mac version of Garden Life.

[b]Can I play with other players? Join our friends' gardens?[/b]
Unfortunately, Garden Life wasn't originally designed as a multiplayer game, so you can't join up with friends or visit your friends' gardens.

[b]Is any DLC planned after the game's release?[/b]
Two DLCs are available on all platforms. There are no current plans for further DLC content after the release, but we'll let the players if that changes in the future. You can susbcribe to our official newsletter to keep up with all future news on our website: [url=https://www.garden-life-a-cozy-simulator.com/]https://www.garden-life-a-cozy-simulator.com/[/url]

[b]How do I use the photo mode?[/b]
When playing, the key to press in order to get access to the photo mode is displayed at the top of your screen.

[b]Can we date the characters?[/b]
There is no dating in this game.

[h2]About your Garden:[/h2]
[b]Are there seasons in the game? Can you skip them?[/b]
There are four seasons to experience in Garden Life, each lasting 30 in-game days. In the creative mode, they can be changed instantly. There are no adverse effects on the plants in different seasons, but you will notice different items in the shop, different customisation options for the garden fence, and a difference in the price of certain bouquets when you sell them in your stall. 
In story mode, you can't skip seasons. In creative mode, you can go into the shed and change the season by selecting the pictures just underneath the clock.

[b]Can I customize the decorations?[/b]
There is a brush you can purchase from Leslie's shop that can change all of the placeable decoration's colors.

[b]How do we get new seeds and decorations?[/b]
Seeds can be gained from a few ways: purchased from the shop, harvested from established plants, or given as a reward for a request or mission.

[b]How do we get new seed colors?[/b]
When a plant is ready to harvest, you will have a small light (VFX) coming from them. This will indicate a new seed. If the VFX is green, the seed will be the same colour as the plant you are harvesting from, and if it is a pink, the seed will be a different colour as the plant you are harvesting from. In creative mode, all colours are available from the start in the shed.

[b]Can we extend the garden? Can we unlock the garden? How do I unlock the new zones?[/b]
In story mode, play through the game by completing missions and requests for the characters. Once available, use the customisation board at the entrance of the Garden to unlock new areas.

[b]How do we know a plant can climb? Why is my climbing plant not climbing?[/b]
In the plant book inside the shed: you can see the type of plant you have (normal, bush or climbing plant). Climbing plants are: Ivy, Clematis, Morning glory and Jasmine.
Make sure you have placed the plant close to an item that has height (such as a trellis or fence). Cut the top of the plant and check back: climbers can be tricky to get to take, so regular pruning is required.

[b]How do I know my plant is infected?[/b]
You will see a small cloud of black flies and hear a buzzing in the location of the infected plant.

[b]How to get rid of pests?[/b]
You can get a pest removal spray for free in Leslie's shop.

[b]Can I move a plant?[/b]
You are able to move plants with the trowel tool which you can purchase from the shop.

[h2]About the cats:[/h2]
[b]Can we pet the cats?[/b]
You can pet two cats in the garden and one cat in Leslie's shop.

[h2]About the Village:[/h2]
[b]How do I get to the village? [/b]
You can access the vilage by clicking on your bike, clicking on the Village Square sign, or walking to the end of the road.

[b]How to get rocks? How to get sticks?[/b]
Rocks can be found at the start of your game in your garden and then, to get more stones and sticks, you will need to use the shop. You can craft large rocks into smaller ones at the crafting bench in your shed.

[b]Where can I sell things? How do I unlock the stand / stall? Can I sell my bouquets?[/b]
In story mode, play through the game by completing missions and requests for the characters. You will eventually unlock a stall in the village's square where you can sell cut flowers and bouquets.

[h2]About the Greenhouse:[/h2]
[b]How to open the Greenhouse? Do I have to water my plants in the greenhouse?[/b]
In story mode, play through the game by completing missions and requests for the characters.  You will eventually unlock the Greenhouse by paying for repairs and garden cleaning on the board at the entrance to your garden. 
There is an auto-watering system in the greenhouse.

[h2]About the Creative Mode:[/h2]
[b]How to get new seeds?[/b]
In creative mode, you have access to all seeds of all colours in the shed from the start of the game. Seeds can also be bought for free from Leslie's shop.	

[b]Do I have to take care of my plants?[/b]
You still have to take care of your plants.
					
[b]Is there a way to delete everything?[/b]
There is no way to delete everything, but you can start a new save in creative mode.
								
[b]How to change seasons?[/b]
In creative mode, you can go into the shed and change the season by selecting the pictures just underneath the clock.	
	
[h2]You need some help?[/h2]
[b]How to report a bug?[/b]
To report a bug, you can contact us here: https://garden-life.zendesk.com/hc/en-gb 						

Warm whishes,
The Garden Life team 🌼
